card.name: Inside and before drug-name pieces
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a drug or chemical name, or a small word like 'a', 'of' or 'for' right before a drug name. It appears in drug-interaction text, often just before a name that starts with 'a' or 'amine'.

modes.label: Inside chemical names
modes.description: Pieces such as 'yl' or 'pro' partway through a long chemical or drug name.

modes.label: Small word before a drug name
modes.description: A word like 'a' or 'of' that sits just before a drug name is spelled out.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated word pieces, so it suggests no clear output effect beyond continuing a partly spelled word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long drug names and on small words just before a drug name.
